about_short_description.short_description: Dresscode operates as an online store for brands and designers to market and sell women's clothing.

product.name: Online Women's Clothing Store
product.description: An e-commerce platform offering a range of women's clothing items including dresses, tops, skirts, pants, and accessories.

product.name: Vendor Registration Service
product.description: A service allowing brands and designers to register and sell their women's clothing products on the Dresscode online platform.

product.name: Shipping Service
product.description: A logistics service that delivers purchased women's clothing items to customers across Egypt.

product.name: Returns and Exchanges Service
product.description: A customer service allowing returns or exchanges of purchased products within a specified period under certain conditions.

product.name: Size Guide and Measurement Instructions
product.description: A detailed guide to help customers measure their body dimensions accurately for selecting the correct clothing size.
